VERNON THE 8 [V8] LIVE 2026 - GOYANG (2026.7.11) [Weverse] (1080p HD)​


​
The VERNON THE 8 [V8] LIVE 2026 - GOYANG concerts were the highly anticipated, first solo shows by SEVENTEEN's newest dynamic unit, V8 (consisting of members Vernon and The8). The events took place on July 11 and July 12, 2026, at KINTEX Exhibition Hall 1 in Goyang, South Korea. The unit's name, V8, symbolizes their powerful synergy and driving force, much like an 8-cylinder engine. Following the release of their debut album on June 29, 2026, the duo hit the stage in Goyang for a high-energy, all-standing format concert that thrilled a combined total of 15,000 fans across both dates.
